extracted.name: Mexican Pasta
extracted.description: This Mexican pasta is delicious. Seashell pasta is tossed with a quickly cooked sauce of tomatoes, onion, bell pepper, corn, black beans, salsa, and taco seasoning.
ingredient_lines: 1 (14.5 ounce) can peeled and diced tomatoes
instruction_lines: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente; drain.
While pasta is cooking, heat olive oil over medium heat in a large skillet. Cook onions and bell pepper in oil until lightly browned, about 10 minutes.
Stir in corn and heat through. Stir in black beans, tomatoes, salsa, olives, seasoning mix, and salt and pepper and cook until thoroughly heated, about 5 minutes.
Toss sauce with cooked pasta and serve.
